records.title: WebConfessional
contentWarnings: Themes include manipulation, self-harm and suicidal ideation, threats and violence, cultism, and references to gore.
records.accessCaution: Read the creator content warnings before playing. This is a creator age restriction, not an independent age rating.
records.evidenceSummary: The official creator page explicitly states an 18+ audience and lists these warnings.

records.title: BLUEJEWELED
records.accessCaution: Creator describes this as a Bejeweled 3 mod. The page offers a browser embed and Windows/macOS builds; whether any build requires a separate base-game installation is not established.
records.reuseCaution: Do not infer permission to reuse Bejeweled assets from the mod description.
records.evidenceSummary: Creator description and listed access formats were read. No build was executed or installed.

records.title: Desktop Goose
records.accessCaution: A desktop companion that moves the cursor and displays notes/memes, rather than a standalone challenge or campaign game. Windows/macOS downloads; no installation or runtime test performed.
records.evidenceSummary: Creator describes a desktop companion and its desktop interactions.

records.title: Planet Life
records.accessCaution: Creator warns that the itch-hosted version can lose progress and recommends the separate official host. This warning is attributed; save reliability has not been tested here.
records.evidenceSummary: The prominent creator warning links the official host as the recommended alternative.
